ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels and 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white pixel field across both lobes. A central, high-contrast black mottled region is localized at the fluke base extending into the median notch. A thin, irregular black perimeter tracks the entirety of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 5 to 25 pixels, creating a distinctly jagged topography relative to the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct dark circular pixel clusters on the mid-left lobe and one larger dark spot on the mid-right lobe. Localized yellowish-white high-contrast clusters (barnacles) on the far distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, parallel, diagonal tan-colored linear streaks on the left lobe. One faint reddish-pink linear pixel disruption on the right lobe near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel tan-colored linear abrasions on the left lobe and dense barnacle colonization on both lobe tips.
